1.explanation: Both of these files perform the core DevTools trace processing and map renderer process IDs to thread IDs. In lib/tracehouse/trace-processor.js the findMainFramePidTids function collects processId from FrameCommittedInBrowser events (but the event only has processPseudoId), causing undefined pids and ultimately the thrown error. lib/lh-trace-processor.js invokes this logic as part of the public trace‐processing API. Fixing the mapping (e.g. falling back to processPseudoId or the startingPid when processId is absent) requires editing these files.
1.bug_scenario: When Lighthouse (v10.0.1) is run programmatically against https://treo.sh, the trace‐processor’s findMainFramePidTids helper sees a FrameCommittedInBrowser event whose args.data contains only processPseudoId (e.g. “0x1c072e100”) and no processId. Because the code unconditionally maps frameCommittedEvts to their .data.processId, it produces mainFramePids = [undefined]. On the next loop it looks for a CrRendererMain thread for pid undefined, finds none, and throws “Unable to determine tid for renderer process.”

2.explanation:
1) lib/tracehouse/trace-processor.js: This is where findMainFramePidTids lives and where the bug manifests. It only looks at evt.args.data.processId, never checking for processPseudoId. When a trace only supplies processPseudoId, mainFramePids becomes [undefined] and the code throws. 
2) lib/lh-trace-processor.js: This is the public wrapper around tracehouse’s TraceProcessor. Any change to how PIDs are handled in the underlying trace-processor will surface here, so it may require adjustments or re‐exporting of the new logic.
3) core/computed/processed-trace.js: This computed artifact invokes the LHTraceProcessor to produce the processed trace. It propagates the error thrown by findMainFramePidTids, so may need to adapt or catch/fallback when only processPseudoId is present.
2.bug_scenario: When Lighthouse v10 is run programmatically against certain pages (e.g. https://treo.sh), the DevTools trace’s “FrameCommittedInBrowser” event contains only a processPseudoId (no processId). The static function findMainFramePidTids (in trace-processor.js) expects evt.args.data.processId to build the mainFramePids map, so mainFramePids ends up [undefined]. On the next loop it tries to find a CrRendererMain thread whose pid is undefined, fails to find one, and throws “Unable to determine tid for renderer process.”
